description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1782/16 of 30.10.2012, Cad. Map No. 520214 and other amendments
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple entries detailing specific changes to land parcel records, including amendments to parcel numbers, title classifications, ownership status (State/Private), owner names, and the insertion of servitude/access rights. All content falls under land and property-related matters, specifically focusing on land title registration and cadastral record amendments.
